note: Per-scene facts for the agent and for check-video.js. Slot names and word limits must match each scene's registered `slots` (tests/scenes.test.js holds them in step). `minDur` is typical content time at the default copy length; the compiler computes the real minimum from the words. `pictures` lists the continuous style's pictures (pictures/*.js); the tests hold it in step with the registered ones.

swap.note: the one transition between scenes; transitionIn in a spec is ignored

pan.note: the continuous style only: the camera pans level from one place to the next; its length is set per change from how far it travels

hook-headline.claims: optional, inline as {F1} in the headline
hook-headline.signature: words rise through a mask line, staggered
hook-headline.notFor: a hook that is one figure on its own: use big-number

big-number.signature: counter rolls on expo-out to the exact value, holds >= 1.5 s
big-number.notFor: comparing two figures: use before-after or compare-bars

kicker-title.job: context or a section title: what, who, when
kicker-title.signature: masked line reveal, bar draws above
kicker-title.notFor: a finding with a number: give it an evidence scene

compare-bars.data: bars: 2-6 of { label (<= 3 words), value: claim id, emph?, forecast? }
compare-bars.signature: bars grow from zero, value labels land at their ends
compare-bars.notFor: change over time (trend-line), parts of a whole (share-split), negative values

trend-line.data: series: data table id { x[], y[] (null = gap), unit, source, locator, forecastFrom? }; end?: claim id; highlight?: [from, to]
trend-line.signature: line draws left to right, end dot and value
trend-line.notFor: unordered categories, fewer than 3 points, more than one line

share-split.job: part of a whole (never a pie)
share-split.data: parts: 1-5 of { label, value: claim id in %, emph? }; style?: waffle | bar
share-split.signature: waffle cells or stacked segments fill in order
share-split.notFor: shares that don't come from one whole, or add past 100%

ranked-list.data: rows: 2-5 of { label (<= 4 words), value: claim id, emph? }, in rank order
ranked-list.signature: rows arrive by rank, bars grow

before-after.data: before, after: { label (<= 3 words), value: claim id }
before-after.signature: before lands muted, a rule wipes, after lands in ink
before-after.notFor: values in different units, or more than two states

steps.signature: one marker travels step to step

quote.data: a claim with quote: true, verbatim (source sentence) and display (on-screen excerpt, a substring of verbatim)
quote.signature: words brighten in reading order, attribution after
quote.notFor: paraphrase, or a person the source doesn't quote

bullet-stack.signature: each point enters as the previous settles
bullet-stack.notFor: points that each carry a figure: give the strongest its own scene

photo-pan.data: copy.image: a data:image/... URI from the user
photo-pan.signature: fades in and holds still, clipped to the chart area; no zoom
photo-pan.notFor: fetched, stock or generated images: never

source-card.job: sources and dates; always in every cut
source-card.notFor: anything else: it is last, or just before the outro

outro.job: the user's own name, logo and call to action
outro.data: meta.brand.logo, only if the user gave one
outro.notFor: invented handles, links or slogans: never

custom.data: draw: name of a painter on Motion.custom { enter, read, draw(ctx, lt, api) }

people.job: a count of people, one dot each (or one per `per`), and shares of them

options.whole: claim id of the count, when the scene shows a share

people.notFor: anything that is not people: visits, accounts, money

dots.job: a small share of anything: 1,000 dots, one per 0.1%, lit along the front
dots.notFor: a count; a share above about 20% (use blocks)

blocks.job: a share as a 10 x 10 stack, one unit per 1%
blocks.notFor: a count; a share below 2% (use dots)

split.job: parts of one whole, each lit in turn, the first (or emph) in the accent
split.key: the unit, then each part with its swatch
split.notFor: shares of different wholes, or more than 100%

columns.job: 2 to 6 values in one unit, standing in a row from zero
columns.key: each value and label in the world
columns.notFor: a long series (use a trend line); parts of a whole

funnel.job: stages that only narrow, each stage's loss a ghost above it
funnel.key: each value and label under the plate
funnel.notFor: stages that grow, or different units

podium.job: a ranking, largest first in the accent, long names wrapped
podium.key: each value and label in the world

ribbon.job: a series over ordered time, drawn left to right; gaps stay gaps, a forecast is ghosted
ribbon.key: the end value, first and last x, the baseline when not zero

building.job: where a finding happens: a home, a bank branch
building.notFor: a cause the source does not state

device.job: a website or app: a laptop or phone with a plain wireframe page

desk.job: work waiting: an unsorted pile, empty trays, a calendar showing when it is due

options.from: an earlier scene whose place the sheets lift off

plinth.job: lifts the place in view (or `at`) for a verdict about it
plinth.notFor: a place that is not blocks
